scope: Separate ordinary full-network LNA extension; frozen SSA pilot remains unchanged
initial_covariance: zero: fixed initial counts, not a Poisson initial law
rates: ordinary deterministic mass-action A^2, all twelve channels, CD->AE coefficient2; not falling-factorial stochastic propensity
mean_and_covariance: m'=f(m); C'=J(m)C+C J(m)^T+sum_r a_r(m) nu_r nu_r^T
time_variance: 1^T C(t_det)1 / (1^T f(m(t_det)))^2, conventional transverse first-passage delta method
Jacobian: analytic full 30-variable Jacobian; checked against finite differences before integration
domain_checks: mean nonnegativity, covariance symmetry and PSD at accepted nodes plus dense samples; numerical checks, not validated enclosures
candidate_variance: 0.5682*N**0.2 supplied externally as a deterministic-candidate coefficient, not fit and not an actual-chain CLT
comparison: reuse fixed main SSA sample variances from original 64/64/16 paths; no new samples and no parameter fitting
cost: log full launch/startup, validation, all solver/refinement attempts and memory; no installations or external sources
